name: Path Dimension of Singletons plus empty set
proof: For n=1 the class is a one-cube and has path dimension one. For n>=2 choose distinct i,j: the traces {i}, empty, {j} form a coordinate-flip path of length two. Every projection is a star (possibly just one edge) with centre the empty trace and singleton leaves. A simple path in a star has at most two edges, so no longer witness exists.
